base_commit: main (process after 20261003-017 is merged; rebase onto main)
branch_policy: Create your work branch from main. Push to the branch only. Never push to main, never touch production, never force-push.
constraints: Work on a branch only; report branch name and head commit SHA.
Do NOT modify .env.push or any secret/config file.
Do NOT deploy or restart anything on production.
context: Jun decided: /thai/ is the single canonical entry point for Thai news. Today Thai news is reachable via /thai/ landing -> /thai/news/ dashboard AND via the Thai tab/region filter on the main /news/ dashboards. Audit the reachable paths, then make /thai/ canonical without dead-ends.
expected_report: Branch name, head commit SHA, list of Thai-news entry paths found + what changed for each.
success_criteria: /thai/ landing clearly leads to /thai/news/ (already does; confirm)
The main /news/ dashboards' Thai tab/region filter either links canonically to /thai/ or is kept purely as an in-place filter -- one coherent rule, documented in the report
No page shows two competing 'Thai news home' links; every Thai entry path resolves to a working page
Existing tests show no new failures vs base

tasks.acceptance: Report lists every Thai-news entry path and the canonical rule applied to each; implementation matches the report
tasks.title: Unify Thai news entry on /thai/
